context:
# Goal
kama round23 build wave. L1 (CloseKama22 identity, coordinator) holds the canonical planner seat; no other rounds. ONE declared C1 CALIBRATION claim (lowest assigned non-retired axis 7; operability 8): `tools/report-landing-audit.py` promises "Errors are never verdicts" and its `git_env` docstring says audited repos cannot redirect it, but REPOSITORY-LOCAL git state still changes or crashes its verdict. L1 probe at base master=4fe9339f8fc3a4a4a479d9c938a850da12f1124d (git 2.56.0, scratch repos, script /tmp/kama-r23-probe/probe.sh) observed: (a) lane `i18n.logOutputEncoding=ISO-8859-1` + non-ASCII subject -> UnicodeDecodeError traceback exit1 (error became a `failed` verdict); (b) invalid UTF-8 bytes in a committed fleet report -> traceback exit1; (c) `git replace` of an omitted round commit -> false clean exit0; (d) `refs/replace/<fabricated 40-hex>` makes a fabricated citation resolve -> false clean exit0; (e) promisor remote + `core.sshCommand` -> lazy fetch EXECUTED a repo-configured command during `cat-file --batch-check`. Candidate direction (not yet decided): bytes-mode git with strict UTF-8 -> EvalError (exit2), global `--no-replace-objects` and `--no-lazy-fetch`, `-c i18n.logOutputEncoding=UTF-8 -c log.follow=false`. The measured claim is a finite fault grid frozen(4fe9339f blob) vs current: faults that crash/flip/execute before -> typed refusal or correct verdict after; controls unchanged; existing selftest 50/50 and historical ledger (rounds10-22 clean via errata) unchanged. This is narrow D4 frontier movement, NOT general untrusted-repository hardening; alternates/clone --shared remain legitimate.
Lane /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kama-shokunin; base master=4fe9339f8fc3a4a4a479d9c938a850da12f1124d.
# Contract
Every `Report:` trailer path is relative to /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kama-shokunin — write it at /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kama-shokunin/<that path>. Reports are append-only once written. Seat output stays under /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kama-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-23/build/ (report + optional out/<YourName>/ artifacts). Never write the fleet root /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin (except reading), sibling lanes, domain sources, global config, ~/.omp, the lane's .jj or Git index, or the lane checkout's tracked files. Every code writer works ONLY in its own scratch clone /tmp/kama-r23/<YourName> made with `git clone --no-hardlinks /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kama-shokunin /tmp/kama-r23/<YourName>` (observed base above); copy deliverables (scripts/patches as `git diff` output) into /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kama-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-23/build/out/<YourName>/. Fault fixtures run only in fresh temp repos under /tmp with GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1; never point lazy-fetch/sshCommand fixtures at a real network host (use example.invalid) and never run audited-repo fixtures against the real lane/fleet repos. Only the L1 integrates. No commits/pushes/jj commands by seats. No nested swarm (executors may spawn at most one read-only labrat). Do not message agent://all.
Read /home/vgpnk/.omp/agent/RULES.md before any install. Tooling authorization (operator 2026-10-19): you may install/upgrade tools that help the task via official channels; record tool/version/channel/reason. ALL pacman transactions are PAUSED host-wide: no pacman, no system upgrade/downgrade, no service restart; use uv tool/npx/official binary into ~/.local/bin or report an L0 need. Never read secrets/credentials/environment values. No REA devices.
# Output
Report: concise findings with exact evidence (path:line, command + observed output/exit, URL + located <=25-word quote + access date for sources). Say what you did NOT verify. Unrun checks are not passes. Name every file you wrote.
